Off by default. This build sends nothing: there is no telemetry client yet. The switch is reserved for a future opt-in report containing only a predicted class and a timing bucket, never an image or document text.
Quality reports on. Nothing is sent in this build.

Sahaaya Drishti identifies Indian notes and coins, reads printed pages aloud and answers disability-scheme questions with citations. It is not a mobility aid and it cannot detect counterfeit notes. It does not estimate distance in metres and it never says a path is clear.

₹500 has 5 bleed lines. ₹200 has 4 bleed lines with 2 circles. ₹100 has 4 bleed lines. ₹50, ₹20 and ₹10 have no bleed lines; use the raised intaglio print and the note size. The ₹20 coin is 12-sided. Checked against RBI on 18 November 2026.
